name: superset-plugin-chart-stratum-donut
description: StratumDonut: double-ring donut for Apache Superset 6.1.0, reference period (outer ring) and comparison period (inner ring), with shares, deltas and a rich legend. Reads the dates from the native PeriodCompare filter.

scripts.build: (tsc --project tsconfig.json --emitDeclarationOnly || node node_modules/typescript/lib/tsc.js --project tsconfig.json --emitDeclarationOnly || npx tsc --project tsconfig.json --emitDeclarationOnly) && npm run build:esm
